title: KaiCore
description: KaiCore, PvP balancing, exploit control, and server QoL for Paper/Spigot. Combat tags, item bans, cooldowns, dimension locks, and more all managed in-game via GUI.
body:
# KaiCore

**This plugin is in beta. Please report bugs via a Discord ticket (Plugin Support).**

A comprehensive server management plugin for Minecraft 1.20+ servers, built for server owners who want full control over their gameplay experience. Everything is managed through an easy-to-use in-game GUI - no config file editing required.

---

## Installation

1. Download the latest `KaiCore.jar` release
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Run `/KaiCore gui` to open the main menu

> **Note:** Some features (like Anti-Xray) require **Paper** or a **Paper fork** (Pufferfish, Purpur, etc.) to function properly. These are noted in the feature list below.

---

## Features

### 🔒 Item Restrictions

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Netherite Ban** | Permanently disable all netherite items and blocks |
| **Item Banlist** | Search for any item and toggle restrictions on/off |
| **Item Limiter** | Set a maximum stack size for a specific item across the whole server |
| **Potion Ban** | Disable specific potion types from being brewed or used |
| **TNT Minecarts** | Ban TNT-filled minecarts from spawning or moving |
| **String Dupers** | Revive the string duplication exploit for farm-friendly string gathering |
| **Pearl Ban** | Disable ender pearls from being thrown |
| **Crystal PVP** | Ban end crystals and prevent them from being placed |
| **Villager Killing** | Block players from killing villagers (optionally only employed ones) |

### ⚔️ Combat

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Combat System** | Combat tagging — players are locked in combat for a set time after dealing or taking damage, preventing logout or pearl escapes |
| **Weapon Cooldowns** | Add stun cooldowns to: Spear, Mace, Shield, Ender Pearl, Wind Charge, Riptide, and Enchanted Golden Apple |
| **Invisibility QOL** | Hide your name from other players while invisible (killing/dying) |

### 🛡️ Protection

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Anti-Xray** | Hide ore generation from x-ray clients *(Paper required)* |
| **Minimap Blocker** | Block **Xaero's Minimap** from being used on your server |
| **Mace Controls** | One-time craft the mace and optionally ban it entirely |
| **Enchant Limit** | Set maximum level caps for any enchantment at the enchanting table and anvil |

### 🌍 World & Gameplay

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Sleep** | One-player sleep — one player sleeping skips the night |
| **Dimensions** | Toggle access to the Nether and The End separately |
| **Infinite Restock** | Villager workstations never stop offering trades |
| **Easy Recipes** | Simplified crafting for Golden Apples and Cobwebs |
| **Locator Bar** | Show a compass pointing to world spawn in your action bar |

### ⚡ Misc

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **/end Command** | Open or close The End dimension on demand |

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/KaiCore gui` | Open the main KaiCore menu |
| `/end open` | Open The End portal |
| `/end close` | Close The End portal |

**Aliases:** `/kaicore`, `/kc`

**Default Permission:** `kaicore.use` (OP only)

---

## GUI Overview

The main menu is a 54-slot inventory with feature icons spread across pages. Each icon shows the current status at a glance.

**Controls:**
- **Left-click** — Toggle the primary option / increase a value
- **Right-click** — Open sub-menus / set secondary options
- Use the arrow slots at the bottom to navigate between pages

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kaicore.use` | OP | Access to the main GUI and all features |
| `kaicore.bypass` | false | Bypass all item restrictions |
| `antiend.use` | OP | Use `/end open` and `/end close` |
| `xaero.ignoredisable` | false | Bypass the Xaero's Minimap block |
| `xaero.ignorefair` | false | Bypass the Xaero's fair mode block |

---

## Recommended Server Software

| Feature | Required |
|---|---|
| Most features | Spigot, Paper, or any 1.20+ fork |
| Anti-Xray | **Paper** or Paper fork (Pufferfish, Purpur, etc.) |

---

📜 TERMS OF SERVICE

🚫 You may NOT claim this plugin as your own

🚫 You may NOT resell or republish this plugin

🚫 You may NOT modify this plugin at all

*Made for server owners who want full control without touching config files.*
